# express

Minimal Express-shaped router for the SEVM stack — a **compatibility target**,
not a reimplementation of the full npm package.

## Usage

```js
import express from './node_modules/express/index.js';

const app = express();
app.get('/api/items', (req, res) => res.json({ items: [] }));
app.post('/api/items', (req, res) => res.status(201).json({ ok: true }));
app.listen(8080, () => console.log('listening on 8080'));
```

## Supported subset

- `app.get/post/put/del(path, handler)`
- `app.listen(port, cb)`
- `req.path`, `req.query`, `req.body`, `req.headers`
- `res.status()`, `res.json()`, `res.send()`, `res.end()`, `res.setHeader()`

## Not implemented (yet)

Middleware chains (`app.use`), body parsing, static file serving, template
engines, virtual hosts — these need Node internals the engine does not expose
yet.
